children.value: > Fact From Story: Pebble, the Twitter alternative previously known as T2, is shutting down.

> > Fact From Story: The would-be X rival had grown a small but engaged community on its microblogging service that aimed to dupe Twitter’s features, from its verification systems to functionality like DMs.
> > > Fact From Story: The company says they’ve run out of time to make Pebble happen.
> > > Fact From Story: The app maxed out at 3,000 daily active users, out of 20,000 registered users.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A company that runs out of time and doesn't have many active users will shut down.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A service that duplicates features of another service is a competitor.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A company that is not competitive enough to stay afloat will shut down.
